To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the most important factors that influence a GPs prescription for an antibiotic in patients with a respiratory tract infection (RTI) are the severity of the symptoms and the GPs own attitude towards the use of antibiotics.

antibiotic use for respiratory tract infections in general practice is high, that there is no clear relationship between antibiotic use and patient characteristics, and that there is a relationship between antibiotic prescribing and GP characteristics.
